o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طلغه (dalġa), from Proto-Turkic *tolkun. Starostin reconstructs Proto-Turkic *dal-g- with unclear meaning. Reflexes of this proto-form are only present in Oghuz languages or as borrowings from them, compare Turkish and Gagauz dalga, Crimean Tatar dalğa and tolqun, Turkmen tolkun.
From söykəmək + -n. Cognate with Turkmen söýenmek.
From apar- + -ıcı. The sense 'host' is a semantic loan from Russian веду́щий (vedúščij).
From həll olunmaq (“to be solved, to dissolve”) + -maz.
